s: yenedaṃ bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyat parigṛhītam amṛtena sarvam | yena yajñas tāyate saptahotā tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: येनेदं भूतं भुवनं भविष्यत् परिगृहीतम् अमृतेन सर्वम् । येन यज्ञस् तायते सप्तहोता तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That immortal [principle] by which all this—past, present, and future—is encompassed, / by which the sacrifice with its seven hotṛs is extended: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yena karmāṇy apaso manīṣiṇo yajñe kṛṇvanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ | yad apūrvaṃ yakṣam antaḥ prajānāṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: येन कर्माण्य् अपसो मनीषिणो यज्ञे कृण्वन्ति विदथेषु धीराः । यद् अपूर्वं यक्षम् अन्तः प्रजानां तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That by which active and wise men perform rites in the sacrifice, and sages in gatherings, / that peerless wonder within living beings: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yat prajñānam uta ceto dhṛtiś ca yaj jyotir antar amṛtaṃ prajāsu | yasmān na ṛte kiṃ cana karma kriyate tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यत् प्रज्ञानम् उत चेतो धृतिश् च यज् ज्योतिर् अन्तर् अमृतं प्रजासु । यस्मान् न ऋते किं चन कर्म क्रियते तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That which is higher knowledge, consciousness, and steadfastness, that immortal light within living beings, / without which no action whatsoever is performed: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yaj jāgrato dūram udaiti daivaṃ tad u suptasya tathaivaiti | dūraṃgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotir ekaṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यज् जाग्रतो दूरम् उदैति दैवं तद् उ सुप्तस्य तथैवैति । दूरंगमं ज्योतिषां ज्योतिर् एकं तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That divine [entity] which wanders far away when one is awake, and likewise departs when one is asleep, / that far-ranging one, the single light of lights: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yasmin ṛcas sāma yajūṃṣi yasmin pratiṣṭhitā rathanābhāv ivārāḥ | yasmiṃś cittaṃ sarvam otam prajānāṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यस्मिन् ऋचस् साम यजूंषि यस्मिन् प्रतिष्ठिता रथनाभाव् इवाराः । यस्मिंश् चित्तं सर्वम् ओतम् प्रजानां तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That in which the Ṛg, Sāman, and Yajus formulas are fixed like spokes in the hub of a chariot wheel, / in which all the consciousness of living beings is woven: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: suṣārathir aśvān iva yan manuṣyān nenīyatebhīśubhir vājina iva | hṛtpratiṣṭhaṃ yad ajiraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: सुषारथिर् अश्वान् इव यन् मनुष्यान् नेनीयतेभीशुभिर् वाजिन इव । हृत्प्रतिष्ठं यद् अजिरं जविष्ठं तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That which guides men just as an expert charioteer guides swift horses with reins, / that which is seated in the heart, unaging and swiftest: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yad atra ṣaṣṭhaṃ triśataṃ śarīraṃ yajñasya guhyaṃ navanābham ādyam | daśa pañcatriṃśataṃ yat paraṃ ca tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यद् अत्र षष्ठं त्रिशतं शरीरं यज्ञस्य गुह्यं नवनाभम् आद्यम् । दश पञ्चत्रिंशतं यत् परं च तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That which is here the three-hundred-and-sixtieth, the body, the secret, nine-navelled, primal [aspect] of the sacrifice, / that which is ten, thirty-five, and beyond: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: ye pañca pañcā daśataṃ śataṃ ca sahasraṃ ca niyutaṃ nyarbudaṃ ca | te yajñacitteṣṭakāttaṃ śarīraṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: ये पञ्च पञ्चा दशतं शतं च सहस्रं च नियुतं न्यर्बुदं च । ते यज्ञचित्तेष्टकात्तं शरीरं तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Those fifty-five, the decade, the hundred, / the thousand, the ten thousand, and the hundred million— / they are the body built of sacrificial-consciousness bricks: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: vedāham etaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntam ādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt | tasya yoniṃ paripaśyanti dhīrās tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: वेदाहम् एतं पुरुषं महान्तम् आदित्यवर्णं तमसः परस्तात् । तस्य योनिं परिपश्यन्ति धीरास् तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: I know this great Puruṣa, sun-colored, beyond darkness; / the wise perceive his source: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yena karmāṇi pracaranti dhīrā viprā vācā manasā karmaṇā ca | saṃvidam anu saṃyanti prāṇinas tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: येन कर्माणि प्रचरन्ति धीरा विप्रा वाचा मनसा कर्मणा च । संविदम् अनु संयन्ति प्राणिनस् तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: By which the wise and inspired perform deeds in speech, thought, and action, / [and by which] living beings attain awareness: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: ye mano hṛdayaṃ ye ca devā ye antarikṣe bahudhā caranti | ye śrotraṃ cakṣuṣī saṃcaranti tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: ये मनो हृदयं ये च देवा ये अन्तरिक्षे बहुधा चरन्ति । ये श्रोत्रं चक्षुषी संचरन्ति तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Those gods who [move in] the mind and the heart, and those who move manifoldly in the intermediate space, / those who move through the ear and the eyes: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yena dyaur ugrā pṛthivī cāntarikṣaṃ ye parvatāḥ pradiśo diśaś ca | yenedaṃ jagad vyāptaṃ prajānāṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: येन द्यौर् उग्रा पृथिवी चान्तरिक्षं ये पर्वताः प्रदिशो दिशश् च । येनेदं जगद् व्याप्तं प्रजानां तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: By which the mighty heaven, earth, and the intermediate space [are held], by which the mountains, intermediate regions, and cardinal points [are sustained], / by which this world of creatures is pervaded: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yenedaṃ sarvaṃ jagato babhūvur ye devā api mahato jātavedāḥ | tad evāgnitapaso jyotir ekaṃ tan me manaś śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: येनेदं सर्वं जगतो बभूवुर् ये देवा अपि महतो जातवेदाः । तद् एवाग्नितपसो ज्योतिर् एकं तन् मे मनश् शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: By which all this of the world arose, and the gods, including great Jātavedas; / that very single light of the heat of fire: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: acintyaṃ cāprameyaṃ ca vyaktāvyaktaparaṃ ca yat | sūkṣmāt sūkṣmataraṃ jñānaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: अचिन्त्यं चाप्रमेयं च व्यक्ताव्यक्तपरं च यत् । सूक्ष्मात् सूक्ष्मतरं ज्ञानं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: That which is unthinkable and immeasurable, beyond the manifest and the unmanifest, / knowledge subtler than the subtle: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: asti vināśayitvā sarvam idaṃ nāsti punas tathaivā dṛṣṭaṃ dhruvaṃ | asti nāsti hitaṃ madhyamaṃ padaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: अस्ति विनाशयित्वा सर्वम् इदं नास्ति पुनस् तथैवा दृष्टं ध्रुवं । अस्ति नास्ति हितं मध्यमं पदं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Having destroyed all this, 'it is'; then it is 'it is not'; likewise, it is seen as firm; / 'it is' and 'it is not'—beneficial is the middle state: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: asti nāsti viparīto pravāho 'sti nāsti sarvaṃ vā idaṃ guhyam | asti nāsti parāt paro yat paraṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: अस्ति नास्ति विपरीतो प्रवाहो ऽस्ति नास्ति सर्वं वा इदं गुह्यम् । अस्ति नास्ति परात् परो यत् परं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: 'It is' and 'it is not' is the inverted stream; all this is 'it is' and 'it is not', or hidden; / 'it is' and 'it is not', higher than the highest, that which is transcendent: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: parāt parataraṃ yasya tatparāc caiva tat paraṃ | tatparāt paratojñeyaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: परात् परतरं यस्य तत्पराच् चैव तत् परं । तत्परात् परतोज्ञेयं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Higher than the highest is that to which it belongs, and higher than that transcendent is the supreme, / beyond that transcendent it is to be known: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: parāt parataro brahma tatparāt parato hariḥ | tatparāt parato hy eṣa tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: परात् परतरो ब्रह्म तत्परात् परतो हरिः । तत्परात् परतो ह्य् एष तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Brahman is higher than the highest; Hari is higher than that transcendent; / and higher than that transcendent indeed is this: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: gobhir juṣṭo dhanena hy āyuṣā ca balena ca | prajayā paśubhiḥ puṣkalādyaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: गोभिर् जुष्टो धनेन ह्य् आयुषा च बलेन च । प्रजया पशुभिः पुष्कलाद्यं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Favored with cattle, with wealth, with lifespan, and with strength, / abundant with offspring and livestock: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: prayataḥ praṇavo nityaṃ paramaṃ puruṣottamaṃ | oṃkāraṃ param ātmānaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: प्रयतः प्रणवो नित्यं परमं पुरुषोत्तमं । ओंकारं परम् आत्मानं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Constant is the concentrated syllable Oṃ, directed toward the supreme Puruṣottama; / [meditating on] the sound Oṃ as the supreme Self: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yo vai vedādiṣu gāyatrī sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ | yad dviruktaṃ tathādvyaiśyaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यो वै वेदादिषु गायत्री सर्वव्यापी महेश्वरः । यद् द्विरुक्तं तथाद्व्यैश्यं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: He who is the Gāyatrī at the beginning of the Vedas, the all-pervading Maheśvara; / that which is twice-spoken and likewise non-dual lordship: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yo vai veda mahādevam paramaṃ puruṣottamaṃ | yaḥ sarvaṃ yasya cit sarvaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यो वै वेद महादेवम् परमं पुरुषोत्तमं । यः सर्वं यस्य चित् सर्वं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: He who knows Mahādeva, the supreme Puruṣottama; / he who is all, whose consciousness is all: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: yo 'sau sarveṣu vedeṣu pathate hy aja īśvaraḥ | akāyo nirguṇo dhyātvā tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: यो ऽसौ सर्वेषु वेदेषु पथते ह्य् अज ईश्वरः । अकायो निर्गुणो ध्यात्वा तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: He who is recited in all the Vedas as the unborn Lord; / having meditated upon him as bodiless and devoid of qualities: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: kailāśaśikhare ramye śaṃkarasya śubhe gṛhe | devatās tatra modyanti tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: कैलाशशिखरे रम्ये शंकरस्य शुभे गृहे । देवतास् तत्र मोद्यन्ति तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: On the delightful peak of Kailāsa, in the auspicious dwelling of Śaṅkara, / the gods rejoice there: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: kailāśaśikharābhāsā hi bhavad girisaṃsthitāḥ | nīlakaṇṭhaṃ trinetraṃ ca tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: कैलाशशिखराभासा हि भवद् गिरिसंस्थिताः । नीलकण्ठं त्रिनेत्रं च तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: Resembling the peak of Kailāsa, established on the mountain, / [meditating on] the blue-throated and three-eyed one: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: ābrahmastambaparyantaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram | utpātitaṃ jagad vyāptaṃ tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: आब्रह्मस्तम्बपर्यन्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् । उत्पातितं जगद् व्याप्तं तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: From Brahman down to a clump of grass, the three worlds with the moving and unmoving, / the brought-forth universe is pervaded: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: ya imaṃ śivasaṃkalpam sadā dhyāyanti brāhmaṇāḥ | te paramokṣaṃ gamiṣyanti tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: य इमं शिवसंकल्पम् सदा ध्यायन्ति ब्राह्मणाः । ते परमोक्षं गमिष्यन्ति तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: The brāhmaṇas who constantly meditate on this Śivasaṃkalpa / shall attain supreme liberation: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.

s: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe sugandhiṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ | urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyor mukṣīya māmṛtāt tan me manaḥ śivasaṃkalpam astu ||
d: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे सुगन्धिं पुष्टिवर्धनं । उर्वारुकम् इव बन्धनान् मृत्योर् मुक्षीय मामृतात् तन् मे मनः शिवसंकल्पम् अस्तु ॥
m: We worship the three-eyed one, fragrant, increaser of nourishment; / like a cucumber from its stalk, may I be released from death, not from immortality: may that mind of mine be of auspicious resolve.
